goal: P09–P10 human editorial review queue in backend/routers/ and frontend/src/app/admin/.
summary: Implemented P09–P10 human editorial review queue, four-eyes author/reviewer separation, dispute resolution ledger, and rights sign-off across backend/services/history_governance.py, backend/routers/history.py, backend/apischemas/history.py, and frontend/src/app/admin/editorial/. Established strict peer review governance ensuring authors cannot self-approve their own drafts, automated AI agents cannot approve or publish claims through API, and disputed or rights-restricted materials are blocked from publication.

invariants_enforced.structured_review_queue: GET /api/v1/admin/editorial/queue provides structured filtering of drafts, claims, and entities awaiting editorial evaluation, with real-time summary KPI metrics (pending, in review, disputed, needs source, needs rights, AI drafts, verified).
invariants_enforced.author_reviewer_separation_four_eyes: Four-Eyes Principle strictly blocks an author from verifying or publishing their own submissions (created_by == actor_id), returning HTTP 403 Forbidden with code HISTORY_SELF_APPROVAL_FORBIDDEN. Independent peer human review is mandatory.
invariants_enforced.anti_ai_self_approval_guardrail: Automated AI agent accounts (is_ai_agent=True or bot accounts) are prohibited from approving, verifying, or publishing drafts through the API (HTTP 403 Forbidden with code HISTORY_AI_APPROVAL_FORBIDDEN), guaranteeing human accountability.
invariants_enforced.dispute_resolution_ledger: Systematic tracking of scholarly contradictions and claim disputes via GET /api/v1/admin/editorial/disputes and POST /api/v1/admin/editorial/disputes/resolve, capturing substantive adjudication rationale, resolution status (resolved/upheld), and immutable audit logs.
invariants_enforced.rights_signoff_and_publication_gate: Formal IP/licensing sign-off via POST /api/v1/admin/editorial/rights-signoff attaching rights owner, license, and legal basis to sources and assets. Publication gate strictly rejects claims or entities bound to restricted or revoked sources.
invariants_enforced.non_editorial_role_protection: Non-editorial users (learners, guests, unauthenticated) are blocked from accessing the editorial queue, dispute ledger, or performing review actions (HTTP 401/403).
invariants_enforced.persistence_and_auditability: All editorial state transitions, dispute adjudications, and rights approvals append tamper-evident entries to historical_content_audit_log with actor attribution, diffs, and review notes, persisting across sessions and reloads.

endpoints_delivered.description: Lists claims, entities, and sources in the review queue with summary counters and filters (item_type, status, origin, search).
Executes review actions (submit_for_review, verify, publish, reject, flag_dispute) enforcing four-eyes author/reviewer separation and anti-AI guardrails.
Queries the dispute resolution ledger for active and resolved historiographical disputes.
Adjudicates disputes with human accountability, resolution rationale, and optional source attachments.
Records legal rights sign-off (cleared/verified/public_domain) for sources, assets, or claims.

frontend_delivered.description: Server page defining metadata and rendering the Editorial Review client.
Interactive Next.js client component with review queue table, 4-eyes author disablement warning, AI vs Human badges, review modals, dispute resolution ledger, and rights sign-off form.

test_cases.name: test_editorial_queue_retrieval_and_filtering
test_cases.description: Verifies that GET /api/v1/admin/editorial/queue lists pending items with accurate summary metrics, AI draft flags, and status filters.

test_cases.name: test_four_eyes_author_reviewer_separation_enforced
test_cases.description: Verifies that an author cannot verify or publish their own claim (HTTP 403 HISTORY_SELF_APPROVAL_FORBIDDEN), while an independent peer reviewer can.

test_cases.name: test_negative_abuse_ai_agent_cannot_approve_own_draft_or_any_draft
test_cases.description: Negative abuse test asserting that automated AI bot accounts receive HTTP 403 HISTORY_AI_APPROVAL_FORBIDDEN when attempting to approve or transition drafts.

test_cases.name: test_non_editorial_roles_strictly_forbidden
test_cases.description: Negative abuse test asserting that unauthenticated requests receive 401 and learners/guests receive 403 when trying to access the editorial queue or submit reviews.

test_cases.name: test_dispute_resolution_ledger_workflow
test_cases.description: Verifies dispute flagging, ledger indexing in GET /api/v1/admin/editorial/disputes, and human adjudication in POST /api/v1/admin/editorial/disputes/resolve.

test_cases.name: test_rights_signoff_workflow_and_publication_gate
test_cases.description: Verifies rights sign-off via POST /api/v1/admin/editorial/rights-signoff and asserts that claims bound to restricted or revoked sources are rejected from publication.

test_cases.name: test_editorial_lifecycle_e2e_persistence
test_cases.description: End-to-end verification of complete P09–P10 lifecycle across Draft -> Review -> Peer Verification -> Rights Sign-off -> Publication, with DB persistence and 5-stage audit trail.
